name: Unverified ChainBridge-style bridge with no-op role check
summary: The unverified ChainBridge-style Bridge 0x8de7eaba compiled an AccessControl whose role check never reverts (both branches of _checkRole return), so grantRole() let anyone take DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. The attacker's contract granted itself admin and called adminWithdraw to pull the ERC20 handler's 10,463.64 DAI; copycats repeated it as users deposited more DAI over the next ten weeks.
notes: Defect from bytecode: grantRole (0x2f2ff15d) routes to a role check that jumps to the return label whether or not hasRole holds; a debug_traceCall of grantRole(0x00, 0x...dead) from 0x...dead at block 41770501 writes the role slot. Only the deployer and its successor admin 0xe9fcb406 granted roles before the anchor.

Campaign: every later grantRole or adminWithdraw by a non-admin caller (campaign.mjs plus the handler's DAI transfers); three in blocks 42463654-42463692 named a fake handler and took nothing. Loss is the handler's net DAI outflow per transaction (loss.mjs); 0x8f103d1e's repeated deposit-and-withdraw transactions count only their net drain.
